facts.fact: Paratus says its 2,000 km Goma-Mombasa (G2M) terrestrial fibre route, which passes through Nairobi and ends at Mombasa on the Kenyan coast, is live and carrying traffic; the Kenyan Nairobi-Mombasa part is operator fibre, and the document gives no go-live date so the 2026-09-09 publication date is used.
